Applications are invited from interested and eligible candidates for
admission to the 1st Semester of the Post Graduate Diploma in Computer

under Gauhati University by the Computer Centre, Sipajhar College.

                           per semester
 Eligibility               Graduate in any discipline fronm a recognized university.
 Seats                     Limited - admission on afirst-come-first-served basis

For Admission and Enquiry, contact:
  • Computer Centre, Sipajhar College
  • Phone: 7002106989

Interested candidates are advised to contact the Computer Centre at the
earliest, as the number of seats is limited.
